mechanism: Febuxostat is a potent uricosuric agent that may increase uric acid excretion, while piperacillin-tazobactam is renally eliminated and can reduce renal function; both drugs are primarily metabolized/eliminated renally, increasing potential for drug accumulation and reduced efficacy.
action: Monitor renal function closely, adjust febuxostat dosing if renal impairment develops, and consider alternative antibiotics if feasible in patients with baseline renal compromise.
